Desh TV to broadcast Victory Day concert Live
2017-12-16T00:00:00+06:00 | A Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/arts-entertainment/tv/desh-tv-broadcast-victory-day-concert-live-1505455

Desh TV will broadcast special Victory Day live concert that will be held at the capital's historic Suyhrawardy Udyan. Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina is scheduled to join the programme via video conferencing.

Artistes of Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy will present dance performances at the show, alongside music by Momtaz, Souls, Dalchhut, Shaheen Samad, Timir Nandi, Indra Mohan Rajbangshi and Rafiqul Alam. Rokeya Prachi and Tania Hossain will emcee the concert.

Produced by Alamgir Hossain, the concert will be broadcast live from 3pm to 11pm today.
